text:
In March 2018 our record converges on a single day. On 2018-03-22, 36 of us said "the fiscal year," 35 said "the opioid epidemic," 27 said "omnibus spending bill," 26 said "for disease control" and 26 said "the opioid crisis," while 24 said "centers for disease control." The spending measure and the epidemic arrived together in our mouths.

Earlier that month, 28 of us said "secretary of state" on 2018-03-13, and on 2018-03-16, 27 of us issued a "statement on the passing of."

We did not originate most of this language. "The opioid epidemic" first appears in the ledger on 2015-02-10 from Chuck Grassley; "the opioid crisis" on 2015-02-09 from Tim Kaine; "omnibus spending bill" on 2014-01-06 from Chellie Pingree. We were reciting a script already three years old, arriving at its peak on one shared day.
